candidate_pool: 21 frozen requests, 105 frozen candidates; no additional coordinates
primary_endpoint: ROI-equal MSE of original-valid points to frozen laser nearest vertices
success: strictly smaller primary MSE than photo_U11; no additional <=1mm to >1mm harms versus photo_U11, using incumbent as reference
real_error_budgets_status: ASSUMED, not calibrated, no real-data coverage guarantee
denominator: all original valid neighbors; inactive intervals have zero weight in the support objective
informative: finite angular interval with radius <=5mm and positive central depth
point_control: same informative mask and denominator; replace each interval by its central depth
certain_support: entire informative interval inside candidate +/-5mm band
ranking: highest certain support among candidates and incumbent; tie by largest individual U11 NCC, then lower candidate ID
override: winner is a new candidate >=10mm from incumbent, lower support >=0.2 and exceeds every competitor >=10mm away upper support by >0.05; require >=12 valid neighbors
joint_extra_gate: winner has any frozen U11 source-view NCC >=0.6; not claimed independent evidence
near_competitors: not distinguished by the interval dominance claim; not a transitive cluster or a true-geometry certificate
interpretation: Point control isolates interval contribution; all new joint arms also relax old two-view NCC gate, which must not be credited to interval theory.
